title: Characterization of a Single Nondeterministic Step
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ and $v$ be bit strings, let $s$ and $c'$ be natural numbers, and let $b$ be a bit. Suppose there is a function $sp$ from natural numbers to natural numbers such that $N$ uses at most $sp(n)$ space on inputs of length $n$, and suppose $sp(|x|)\le s$. Then the encoded configuration reached by running the coin-fixed machine for $N$ on $x$ using choice string $v$ has a step to the configuration encoded by $c'$ within the space window $s$ if and only if $c'$ is the encoding of the configuration reached using choice string $v$ followed by $b$.
